[5:04PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow movement when descending from the CMS Bridge inbound Offin Canal Market, primarily due to high vehicular volume and active market activities in the area. However, traffic flow improves immediately after Offin Canal Market, with a smooth stretch from that point to Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Broad Street through to Apongbon, including the under-bridge route connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, is experiencing steady movement, though slightly impacted by the evening rush and nearby market activity.

Traffic on Eko Bridge heading inbound to Apongbon and connecting to CMS remains free-flowing. Similarly, the descent from Idumota Bridge towards Ebute-Ero, including the stretch through Leventis via UBA Roundabout to inner and outer Marina, is moving well without obstruction.

There are currently no impediments, and our personnel are actively stationed at their posts and performing their duties effectively.
